title: Film Censorship Correspondence

page_data.en:
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
C. S. B. REGIST.
Cr. & Sp) Br. Regy.
27 / 6 / 32
May / 23, 32.

Film Censorship Correspondence.

D. S. I. Cole

Sir,

With reference to the attached I beg to state that
I have seen Superintendent Mitchell in regard to this matter
and it is suggested that no change be made in the existing
arrangements for the despatch of letters as the Central
Registry can deal with all correspondence providing it is
received before the office closes.

The Central Registry is closed on Sundays and official
holidays. It would be advisable, therefore, if some
arrangement could be arrived at for the despatch of important
letters and documents during holidaysperiods.

I am, Sir,
Your obedient servant,

〔此处为手写签名〕
D. S. I.

P. A., Crime.

Officer i/c Special Branch.
page_data.zh:
上海公共租界工部局警务处
中央登记处
刑事与特别分支登记处
1932年6月27日
1932年5月23日

电影审查通信

D. S. I. 科尔

先生：

关于附件事宜，谨此呈报，本人已就此事与米切尔（Mitchell）警司会面。建议维持现有的信件发送安排，不作变更，因为只要在办公时间结束前收到，中央登记处即可处理所有往来信函。

中央登记处在星期日及法定假日关闭。因此，若能就节假日期间重要信函及文件的发送达成某种安排，将更为妥当。

此致
敬礼

〔此处为手写签名〕
D. S. I.

助理副督察，刑事科

特别分支主管警官
